REQ-L2-001.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-001.primary_text: The vehicle owner shall be able to securely pair their smartphone with the electric two-wheeler to enable digital key functionality.

REQ-L3-001.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-001.primary_text: The E-Key 2W system shall support the secure provisioning of a digital key from the mobile application to the vehicle-side controller via the cloud lifecycle service.
REQ-L3-001.verification_criteria: Test: Verify end-to-end key provisioning flow.

REQ-L4-001.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-001.primary_text: The digital key enrollment process shall complete within 15 seconds under nominal network conditions.
REQ-L4-001.verification_criteria: Test: Measure end-to-end enrollment time over 20 runs.

REQ-L5-001.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-001.primary_text: The Base mobile app shall discover an eligible vehicle via standard BLE and initiate enrollment.
REQ-L5-001.verification_criteria: Test: Verify BLE discovery and enrollment initiation.

REQ-L5-002.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-002.primary_text: The Premium mobile app shall require on-device biometric authentication before initiating enrollment.
REQ-L5-002.verification_criteria: Test: Verify biometric prompt blocks enrollment if failed.

REQ-L5-003.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-003.primary_text: The Base vehicle controller shall unlock using standard BLE RSSI thresholds (-65 dBm).
REQ-L5-003.verification_criteria: Test: Verify BLE RSSI triggers unlock.

REQ-L5-004.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-004.primary_text: The Premium vehicle controller shall unlock using UWB precise ranging to prevent relay attacks.
REQ-L5-004.verification_criteria: Test: Verify UWB triggers unlock and rejects relay attacks.

REQ-L2-002.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-002.primary_text: The rider shall experience seamless, hands-free unlocking and locking of the vehicle based on their physical proximity.
REQ-L2-002.verification_criteria: Demonstration: Show vehicle unlocking as phone approaches.

REQ-L3-002.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-002.primary_text: The system shall automatically unlock or lock the vehicle when an authorized smartphone enters or leaves the defined proximity zone.
REQ-L3-002.verification_criteria: Test: Verify proximity-based unlock and lock actions.

REQ-L4-002.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-002.primary_text: The Premium variant UWB secure ranging handshake shall complete within 800ms.
REQ-L4-002.verification_criteria: Test: Measure UWB handshake latency over 50 runs.

REQ-L5-005.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-005.primary_text: The Fleet vehicle controller shall accept remote unlock commands from the Fleet Dispatcher API.
REQ-L5-005.verification_criteria: Test: Verify Fleet API remote unlock command actuates mechanism.

REQ-L5-006.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-006.primary_text: The vehicle controller shall immediately reject unlock requests from an unrecognized digital key identifier.
REQ-L5-006.verification_criteria: Test: Unknown phone attempts to unlock; verify rejection.

REQ-L2-003.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-003.primary_text: The system shall ensure that only authorized riders with valid permissions can start and ride the vehicle.

REQ-L3-003.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-003.primary_text: The system shall permit ride authorization only when the presented digital key is cryptographically valid, active, and not revoked.
REQ-L3-003.verification_criteria: Test: Verify valid key permits ride, revoked key is rejected.

REQ-L4-003.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-003.primary_text: The vehicle ignition enable signal shall be triggered within 500ms of the mobile app sending the 'Ready to Ride' command.
REQ-L4-003.verification_criteria: Test: Measure time between app command and ignition relay.

REQ-L5-007.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-007.primary_text: The mobile application shall provide a clear UI indicator showing whether ride authorization is currently active.
REQ-L5-007.verification_criteria: Test: Verify rider can view active ride authorization status.

REQ-L5-008.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-008.primary_text: The vehicle controller shall execute a cryptographic challenge-response handshake before enabling ignition.
REQ-L5-008.verification_criteria: Test: Verify ignition is disabled if crypto handshake fails.

REQ-L2-004.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-004.primary_text: The vehicle owner shall be able to share constrained, temporary digital key access with other riders securely.
REQ-L2-004.verification_criteria: Demonstration: Show owner creating a shared key.

REQ-L3-004.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-004.primary_text: The cloud key lifecycle service shall allow an owner to generate and distribute a shared digital key with configurable constraints.
REQ-L3-004.verification_criteria: Test: Verify shared key expires and respects permissions.

REQ-L5-009.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-009.primary_text: The Base cloud service shall enforce time-based expiry constraints on shared keys.
REQ-L5-009.verification_criteria: Test: Verify shared key expires at configured time.

REQ-L5-010.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-010.primary_text: The Premium cloud service shall enforce geofencing constraints on shared keys.
REQ-L5-010.verification_criteria: Test: Verify shared key fails if used outside defined geo-zone.

REQ-L5-011.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-011.primary_text: The mobile application shall display a list of all currently active shared keys and their constraints.
REQ-L5-011.verification_criteria: Test: Verify owner sees active shared keys list.

REQ-L2-005.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-005.primary_text: The vehicle owner shall have the ability to instantly revoke digital key access in case of loss or theft.
REQ-L2-005.verification_criteria: Demonstration: Show owner revoking a key.

REQ-L3-005.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-005.primary_text: The system shall support immediate revocation of a shared digital key, propagating status to vehicle and mobile.
REQ-L3-005.verification_criteria: Test: Verify owner can revoke and measure propagation time.

REQ-L4-005.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-005.primary_text: A revocation command received by the vehicle online shall become effective within 10 seconds.
REQ-L4-005.verification_criteria: Test: Measure online revocation propagation time.

REQ-L5-012.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-012.primary_text: The Fleet cloud service shall support bulk API revocation for up to 1,000 keys simultaneously.
REQ-L5-012.verification_criteria: Test: Verify bulk API revokes 1k keys within 30s.

REQ-L2-006.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-006.primary_text: The system shall allow owners to customize rider access based on specific time windows or usage restrictions.
REQ-L2-006.verification_criteria: Analysis: Review UI/UX and permission schemas.

REQ-L3-006.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-006.primary_text: The system shall support the configuration and enforcement of rider profiles, including time-window access.
REQ-L3-006.verification_criteria: Test: Verify rider access is denied outside time window.

REQ-L5-013.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-013.primary_text: The Premium mobile app shall allow the owner to restrict a specific rider's access to a configured time window.
REQ-L5-013.verification_criteria: Test: Verify owner can set and save time window.

REQ-L5-014.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-014.primary_text: The Fleet Dashboard shall allow admins to assign shift-based profiles to riders.
REQ-L5-014.verification_criteria: Test: Verify rider can only unlock during assigned shift.

REQ-L2-007.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-007.primary_text: The system shall provide a secure, temporary access mode for valet or service personnel.
REQ-L2-007.verification_criteria: Demonstration: Show creation and usage of a temporary service key.

REQ-L3-007.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-007.primary_text: The system shall allow the generation of a temporary service key with predefined, limited permissions.
REQ-L3-007.verification_criteria: Test: Verify temporary service key works only with restricted permissions.

REQ-L5-015.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-015.primary_text: The Base vehicle controller shall limit max speed to 20km/h when a service key is active.
REQ-L5-015.verification_criteria: Test: Verify speed is limited under valet mode.

REQ-L5-016.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-016.primary_text: The Premium vehicle controller shall disable trunk release and limit speed when a service key is active.
REQ-L5-016.verification_criteria: Test: Verify trunk disabled and speed limited.

REQ-L2-008.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-008.primary_text: The system shall maintain a secure, auditable log of all security-relevant events.
REQ-L2-008.verification_criteria: Inspection: Review security event log schema.

REQ-L3-008.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-008.primary_text: The system shall record all failed authorization attempts and expose them only to authorized users.
REQ-L3-008.verification_criteria: Test: Verify failed attempts create event and unauthorized users cannot read.

REQ-L4-006.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-006.primary_text: The Base variant shall retain security logs for a minimum of 1 year.
REQ-L4-006.verification_criteria: Inspection: Verify cloud DB retention policy.

REQ-L4-007.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-007.primary_text: The Premium variant shall retain high-fidelity telemetry and security logs for 5 years immutably.
REQ-L4-007.verification_criteria: Inspection: Verify Data Lake retention and WORM policy.

REQ-L5-017.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-017.primary_text: The Fleet variant shall stream security events to external SIEM systems via Webhook.
REQ-L5-017.verification_criteria: Test: Verify SIEM receives formatted security events.

REQ-L2-009.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-009.primary_text: The user shall be able to remotely check the basic status of the vehicle.
REQ-L2-009.verification_criteria: Demonstration: Show app displaying accurate status.

REQ-L3-009.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-009.primary_text: The system shall periodically synchronize and display the vehicle's latest known connection status and battery.
REQ-L3-009.verification_criteria: Test: Verify app shows latest lock state and battery.

REQ-L5-018.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-018.primary_text: The Base app shall display lock state via standard REST polling every 60s.
REQ-L5-018.verification_criteria: Test: Verify app UI reflects lock state.

REQ-L5-019.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-019.primary_text: The Premium app shall receive real-time lock state updates via WebSockets.
REQ-L5-019.verification_criteria: Test: Verify app updates instantly on lock change.

REQ-L5-020.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-020.primary_text: The Fleet Dashboard shall display real-time telemetry for 10k vehicles via WebSockets.
REQ-L5-020.verification_criteria: Test: Verify dashboard updates 10k pins within 5s.

REQ-L2-010.label: Requirement
REQ-L2-010.primary_text: The vehicle shall remain operable for a limited period if cloud connectivity is temporarily lost.
REQ-L2-010.verification_criteria: Analysis: Review offline grace period risk assessment.

REQ-L3-010.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-010.primary_text: The system shall support a limited offline grace period, allowing ride authorization without real-time cloud validation.
REQ-L3-010.verification_criteria: Test: Verify vehicle permits offline grace and rejects after expiry.

REQ-L4-009.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-009.primary_text: The maximum allowable offline grace period shall be 72 hours.
REQ-L4-009.verification_criteria: Test: Simulate 73 hours offline; verify vehicle rejects ride.

REQ-L5-021.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-021.primary_text: The offline grace mode shall strictly terminate when its configured validity window expires.
REQ-L5-021.verification_criteria: Test: Verify expired offline grace is rejected.

REQ-L3-037.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-037.primary_text: The platform shall enforce TLS 1.3 encryption for all data in transit.
REQ-L3-037.verification_criteria: Inspection: Review network captures for TLS 1.3.

REQ-L3-038.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-038.primary_text: The platform shall enforce AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data at rest in databases and object storage.
REQ-L3-038.verification_criteria: Inspection: Verify database and S3/GCS bucket encryption settings.

REQ-L5-037.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-037.primary_text: The platform shall manage all API keys, database credentials, and cryptographic seeds via a centralized secrets manager.
REQ-L5-037.verification_criteria: Test: Verify no hardcoded secrets exist in source code or environment variables.

REQ-L4-037.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-037.primary_text: The platform shall undergo automated container vulnerability scanning in the CI/CD pipeline before deployment.
REQ-L4-037.verification_criteria: Test: Introduce a CVE into a Dockerfile; verify pipeline blocks deployment.

REQ-L3-039.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-039.primary_text: The Global variant shall enforce data residency (EU in Frankfurt, US in Oregon).
REQ-L3-039.verification_criteria: Inspection: Verify cloud DB region routing.

REQ-L3-040.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-040.primary_text: The Global variant shall comply with CCPA by providing an 'Opt-Out of Sale of Personal Information' mechanism.
REQ-L3-040.verification_criteria: Test: Verify user can toggle opt-out and data sharing ceases.

REQ-L5-038.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-038.primary_text: The system shall provide a 'Right to be Forgotten' API endpoint that permanently deletes all user PII within 30 days.
REQ-L5-038.verification_criteria: Test: Call deletion API; verify DB records are purged.

REQ-L5-039.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-039.primary_text: The mobile app shall implement a granular consent management UI for data collection (analytics, location, push notifications).
REQ-L5-039.verification_criteria: Test: Verify app respects user consent toggles in real-time.

REQ-L5-040.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-040.primary_text: The system shall provide a 'Data Portability' API endpoint allowing users to export all their data in a machine-readable JSON format.
REQ-L5-040.verification_criteria: Test: Call export API; verify JSON contains all user PII and activity logs.

REQ-L4-038.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-038.primary_text: The API Gateway shall enforce rate limiting of 100 requests/minute per user to prevent abuse and DDoS.
REQ-L4-038.verification_criteria: Test: Send 101 requests in 60s; verify 429 Too Many Requests response.

REQ-L4-039.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-039.primary_text: The platform shall utilize read replicas for the primary database to offload read-heavy telemetry queries.
REQ-L4-039.verification_criteria: Analysis: Review database architecture diagram for read replica configuration.

REQ-L5-041.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-041.primary_text: The platform shall serve all static mobile app assets (images, binaries) via a global Content Delivery Network (CDN).
REQ-L5-041.verification_criteria: Test: Request asset from US and EU; verify response from nearest edge location.

REQ-L4-040.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-040.primary_text: Core platform services (Auth, Key Lifecycle) shall be deployed across multiple Availability Zones (Multi-AZ).
REQ-L4-040.verification_criteria: Inspection: Review cloud infrastructure deployment topology.

REQ-L4-041.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-041.primary_text: The platform shall perform automated daily backups of all databases with a Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) window of 35 days.
REQ-L4-041.verification_criteria: Test: Simulate data corruption; restore database to 1 hour prior.

REQ-L3-041.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-041.primary_text: The platform shall implement graceful degradation; if the Cloud Key Service is unreachable, the Mobile App shall cache the last known state and queue actions.
REQ-L3-041.verification_criteria: Test: Block cloud access; verify app queues actions and syncs when restored.

REQ-L5-042.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-042.primary_text: The platform shall aggregate all application, security, and access logs into a centralized logging service.
REQ-L5-042.verification_criteria: Test: Generate log in microservice A; verify it appears in centralized dashboard.

REQ-L4-042.label: Requirement
REQ-L4-042.primary_text: The platform shall trigger automated alerts (PagerDuty/Slack) when API error rates exceed 1% over a 5-minute window.
REQ-L4-042.verification_criteria: Test: Inject 500 errors; verify alert is triggered within 5 minutes.

REQ-L5-043.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-043.primary_text: The platform shall implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) to track request flows across Mobile, API Gateway, and Microservices.
REQ-L5-043.verification_criteria: Test: Generate request; verify trace ID is present in all downstream service logs.

REQ-L5-044.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-044.primary_text: The platform shall implement automated data lifecycle policies, moving telemetry older than 90 days to cold storage.
REQ-L5-044.verification_criteria: Test: Insert record with timestamp > 90 days; verify it moves to cold storage.

REQ-L3-042.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-042.primary_text: The Global variant shall handle all time-based operations (rider profiles, logs) in UTC and convert to local timezone at the presentation layer.
REQ-L3-042.verification_criteria: Test: Create time-window in Tokyo; verify it displays correctly in New York.

REQ-L5-045.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-045.primary_text: The platform shall enforce ISO 8601 standards for all date and time data exchanged via APIs.
REQ-L5-045.verification_criteria: Test: Verify all API JSON responses use 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ' format.

REQ-L5-046.label: Requirement
REQ-L5-046.primary_text: The mobile app shall support dynamic localization for 15 languages based on device OS settings.
REQ-L5-046.verification_criteria: Test: Change device language to Japanese; verify app UI updates.

REQ-L3-043.label: Requirement
REQ-L3-043.primary_text: The mobile application and web dashboards shall comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
REQ-L3-043.verification_criteria: Test: Run automated accessibility scanner (e.g., axe-core); verify zero critical violations.

TC-ENR-001.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-001.description: Validates that a Base variant vehicle can be discovered via BLE and successfully initiates the enrollment sequence.

TC-ENR-002.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-002.description: Validates that a Premium variant vehicle utilizes UWB for secure discovery and enrollment initiation.

TC-ENR-003.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-003.description: Validates the end-to-end flow of provisioning a digital key from the mobile app through the cloud to the vehicle controller.

TC-ENR-004.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-004.description: Measures the total time taken for the digital key enrollment process under nominal network conditions.

TC-ENR-005.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-005.description: Validates that the Base mobile app correctly discovers eligible vehicles using standard BLE protocols.

TC-ENR-006.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-006.description: Validates that the Premium app enforces on-device biometric authentication before allowing key provisioning.

TC-ENR-007.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-007.description: Validates the Fleet cloud service's ability to process bulk CSV uploads for mass key provisioning.

TC-ENR-008.label: TestCase
TC-ENR-008.description: Validates that unauthenticated users are blocked from initiating the digital key enrollment process.

TC-UNL-001.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-001.description: Validates that a Base variant vehicle automatically unlocks when an authorized phone enters the BLE proximity zone.

TC-UNL-002.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-002.description: Validates that a Premium variant vehicle securely unlocks using UWB precise ranging.

TC-UNL-003.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-003.description: Validates the system's proximity policy engine correctly triggers actions when crossing defined boundaries.

TC-UNL-004.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-004.description: Measures the end-to-end unlock latency for the Base variant using BLE RSSI over 50 runs.

TC-UNL-005.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-005.description: Measures the secure ranging handshake latency for the Premium variant using UWB over 50 runs.

TC-UNL-006.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-006.description: Validates that the Base vehicle controller unlocks specifically when BLE RSSI crosses the -64 dBm threshold.

TC-UNL-007.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-007.description: Validates that the Premium UWB system successfully rejects a simulated BLE relay attack.
TC-UNL-007.objective: Verify Premium UWB relay attack prevention.

TC-UNL-008.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-008.description: Validates that the Fleet vehicle controller accepts and executes remote unlock commands via the Fleet API.

TC-UNL-009.label: TestCase
TC-UNL-009.description: Validates that the vehicle controller immediately rejects unlock requests from unrecognized digital key identifiers.

TC-RID-001.label: TestCase
TC-RID-001.description: Validates that an authorized rider with a valid key can successfully start the vehicle.

TC-RID-002.label: TestCase
TC-RID-002.description: Validates that the system permits ride authorization only when the cryptographic key is valid.

TC-RID-003.label: TestCase
TC-RID-003.description: Validates that the system rejects ride authorization attempts using a revoked digital key.

TC-RID-004.label: TestCase
TC-RID-004.description: Measures the latency between the mobile app 'Start' command and the physical ignition relay closure.

TC-RID-005.label: TestCase
TC-RID-005.description: Validates that the mobile app UI correctly displays the active ride authorization status to the rider.

TC-RID-006.label: TestCase
TC-RID-006.description: Validates that the ignition remains disabled if the cryptographic challenge-response handshake fails or times out.
TC-RID-006.objective: Verify crypto handshake failure blocks ignition.

TC-SHR-001.label: TestCase
TC-SHR-001.description: Validates that an authenticated vehicle owner can successfully create and distribute a shared digital key.

TC-SHR-002.label: TestCase
TC-SHR-002.description: Validates that a shared digital key strictly enforces the constraints (e.g., permissions) assigned by the owner.

TC-SHR-003.label: TestCase
TC-SHR-003.description: Validates that a Base variant shared key correctly expires and fails authentication after the configured time window.

TC-SHR-004.label: TestCase
TC-SHR-004.description: Validates that a Premium variant shared key fails authentication if used outside the defined geofencing zone.

TC-SHR-005.label: TestCase
TC-SHR-005.description: Validates that the mobile app correctly renders a list of all active shared keys and their specific constraints.

TC-REV-001.label: TestCase
TC-REV-001.description: Validates that an owner can successfully revoke an active shared digital key via the mobile app.

TC-REV-002.label: TestCase
TC-REV-002.description: Validates that a revocation command successfully propagates from the cloud to the vehicle controller.

TC-REV-003.label: TestCase
TC-REV-003.description: Measures the time taken for a revocation command to propagate from the cloud to the vehicle controller.

TC-REV-004.label: TestCase
TC-REV-004.description: Validates the Fleet API's ability to process bulk revocation requests for up to 1,000 keys simultaneously.

TC-PRF-001.label: TestCase
TC-PRF-001.description: Validates that the Premium mobile app allows an owner to configure and save a specific time-window restriction.

TC-PRF-002.label: TestCase
TC-PRF-002.description: Validates that the cloud policy engine correctly denies ride authorization when attempted outside a configured time window.
TC-PRF-002.objective: Verify policy engine denies outside window.

TC-PRF-003.label: TestCase
TC-PRF-003.description: Validates the functionality of the time-picker UI component within the Premium mobile application.

TC-PRF-004.label: TestCase
TC-PRF-004.description: Validates that the Fleet Dashboard correctly assigns shift-based profiles and restricts rider access accordingly.

TC-VLT-001.label: TestCase
TC-VLT-001.description: Validates that an owner can successfully generate a temporary valet or service key.

TC-VLT-002.label: TestCase
TC-VLT-002.description: Validates that a valet key correctly masks permissions, rejecting any owner-level actions.

TC-VLT-003.label: TestCase
TC-VLT-003.description: Validates that the Base vehicle controller enforces a 20km/h speed limit when a valet key is active.

TC-VLT-004.label: TestCase
TC-VLT-004.description: Validates that the Premium vehicle controller disables the trunk release mechanism when a valet key is active.

TC-SEC-001.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-001.description: Validates that the system correctly logs a security event when an unknown key attempts to unlock the vehicle.

TC-SEC-002.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-002.description: Validates that unauthorized users receive a 403 Forbidden error when attempting to access security event logs.
TC-SEC-002.objective: Verify unauthorized user cannot read logs.
TC-SEC-002.preconditions: User B requests User A logs.

TC-SEC-003.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-003.description: Validates that multiple failed authentication attempts generate distinct, timestamped log events.

TC-SEC-004.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-004.description: Validates that the Base variant cloud database enforces a 1-year retention policy for security logs.

TC-SEC-005.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-005.description: Validates that the Premium variant Data Lake enforces a 5-year immutable (WORM) retention policy.

TC-SEC-006.label: TestCase
TC-SEC-006.description: Validates that the Fleet variant correctly streams security events to an external SIEM via webhook.

TC-STS-001.label: TestCase
TC-STS-001.description: Validates that the mobile app correctly displays the current lock state of the vehicle.

TC-STS-002.label: TestCase
TC-STS-002.description: Validates that the system successfully synchronizes telemetry data from the vehicle to the mobile app.

TC-STS-003.label: TestCase
TC-STS-003.description: Validates that the Base app updates the lock state UI via standard REST polling within 60 seconds.

TC-STS-004.label: TestCase
TC-STS-004.description: Validates that the Premium app receives and displays real-time lock state updates via WebSockets.

TC-STS-005.label: TestCase
TC-STS-005.description: Validates that the Fleet Dashboard can handle and render real-time telemetry updates for 10,000 simulated vehicles.

TC-OFF-001.label: TestCase
TC-OFF-001.description: Validates that the vehicle permits ride authorization during the offline grace period.

TC-OFF-002.label: TestCase
TC-OFF-002.description: Validates that the vehicle rejects ride authorization once the offline grace period has expired.
TC-OFF-002.objective: Verify offline grace rejects after expiry.

TC-OFF-003.label: TestCase
TC-OFF-003.description: Validates that the vehicle's local authorization cache survives a complete power cycle.
TC-OFF-003.objective: Verify local cache survives power cycle.

TC-OFF-004.label: TestCase
TC-OFF-004.description: Validates the strict 72-hour hard limit for the offline grace mode.

TC-OFF-005.label: TestCase
TC-OFF-005.description: Validates the hard timeout logic that strictly terminates offline grace mode.

TC-037.label: TestCase
TC-037.description: Validates that all API and cross-service communication strictly enforces TLS 1.3 encryption.

TC-038.label: TestCase
TC-038.description: Validates that sensitive data stored in databases and object storage is encrypted using AES-256.

TC-039.label: TestCase
TC-039.description: Validates that no hardcoded secrets exist in the source code or environment variables.

TC-040.label: TestCase
TC-040.description: Validates that the CI/CD pipeline automatically blocks deployment if container vulnerabilities are detected.

TC-041.label: TestCase
TC-041.description: Validates that user data for EU residents is strictly routed and stored in the Frankfurt region.

TC-042.label: TestCase
TC-042.description: Validates that US users can successfully toggle the CCPA 'Opt-Out of Sale' mechanism.

TC-043.label: TestCase
TC-043.description: Validates that the 'Right to be Forgotten' API permanently purges all user PII from the database.

TC-044.label: TestCase
TC-044.description: Validates that the mobile app correctly respects user consent toggles for data collection in real-time.

TC-045.label: TestCase
TC-045.description: Validates that the Data Portability API successfully exports all user data in a machine-readable JSON format.

TC-046.label: TestCase
TC-046.description: Validates that the API Gateway enforces a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per user.

TC-047.label: TestCase
TC-047.description: Validates that read-heavy telemetry queries are correctly offloaded to database read replicas.

TC-048.label: TestCase
TC-048.description: Validates that static mobile app assets are served from the nearest global CDN edge location.

TC-049.label: TestCase
TC-049.description: Validates that core platform services are deployed across multiple Availability Zones.

TC-050.label: TestCase
TC-050.description: Validates that the database can be successfully restored to a specific point in time after simulated corruption.

TC-051.label: TestCase
TC-051.description: Validates that the mobile app gracefully degrades and queues actions when cloud connectivity is lost.

TC-052.label: TestCase
TC-052.description: Validates that application logs generated in microservices appear in the centralized logging dashboard.

TC-053.label: TestCase
TC-053.description: Validates that automated alerts are triggered when API error rates exceed the 1% threshold.

TC-054.label: TestCase
TC-054.description: Validates that distributed tracing correctly propagates trace IDs across all downstream services.

TC-055.label: TestCase
TC-055.description: Validates that telemetry records older than 90 days are automatically moved to cold storage.

TC-056.label: TestCase
TC-056.description: Validates that time-based operations are stored in UTC and correctly converted to local timezones.

TC-057.label: TestCase
TC-057.description: Validates that all API JSON responses strictly adhere to ISO 8601 date and time formatting.

TC-058.label: TestCase
TC-058.description: Validates that the mobile app UI dynamically updates to Japanese when the device OS language is changed.

TC-059.label: TestCase
TC-059.description: Validates that the mobile application and web dashboards meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
